mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO decreased by more than 2% over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals rising inflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real returns are eroded.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month, it signals strong labor market conditions, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 jobs in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) both increase by more than 1% month-over-month, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both increase > 1% MoM
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where both HOUST and RSAFS increased by more than 1% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 0.5% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals an inflationary environment with accommodative monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% month-over-month.
